t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on a warm limestone background. Eyebrow label and wordmark over a hairline rule, then a large light-weight navy sans headline in sentence case and a one-line caveat. Left: an unframed engraved line-hatched macro drawing of a pipe joint in navy hatch lines, bleeding off the left edge, with a few hairline leaders and one steel-blue dimension line. Right: a numbered three-column table with a full hairline grid and bracketed mono column codes for <CONTENT>. No fills, no shadows.
